doNotHandEdit: Change the line in the page, then re-run the generator.
why: Mascot, pickers, home cards and journey lines. Not a mode's own lines, but reachable inside one -- which is why m1 was not in fact fully voiced.

format.why: matches the times-tables set exactly, so a chain that crosses sets does not change timbre or level mid-sentence

provenance.REQUIRED_BEFORE_SHIPPING: AUDIO-DIRECTION.md: tool, model, date and the prompt or voice. Filled at render time. A file that arrives without them cannot be published.
provenance.voiceNote: The same voice as the times-tables set, deliberately. A second voice design would be audible the moment a chain crossed sets.

journey arrival at Earth

lines.text: Earth is our home planet — the only place we know with oceans, trees and you!
lines.note: journey fact 1 at Earth

lines.text: Earth spins all the way round once every day. That is what makes morning and night!
lines.note: journey fact 2 at Earth

lines.text: Water covers most of the Earth. From space, our planet looks blue!
lines.note: journey fact 3 at Earth

lines.text: Earth has a blanket of air all around it, and that air is what you breathe.
lines.note: journey fact 4 at Earth
journey arrival at the Moon

lines.text: Footprints on the Moon never blow away, because the Moon has no wind at all!
lines.note: journey fact 1 at the Moon

lines.text: The Moon has no light of its own. It shines because the Sun shines on it!
lines.note: journey fact 2 at the Moon

lines.text: On the Moon you would weigh much less, so you could jump ever so high!
lines.note: journey fact 3 at the Moon

lines.text: The Moon goes round and round the Earth, like a friend who never leaves.
lines.note: journey fact 4 at the Moon
journey arrival at Mars

lines.text: Mars is called the Red Planet, because it is covered in rusty red dust!
lines.note: journey fact 1 at Mars

lines.text: Mars has two little moons. They are called Phobos and Deimos!
lines.note: journey fact 2 at Mars

lines.text: The biggest volcano in the whole solar system is on Mars. Its name is Olympus Mons!
lines.note: journey fact 3 at Mars

lines.text: Robots from Earth are driving about on Mars, taking photographs of the dust.
lines.note: journey fact 4 at Mars
journey arrival at the Asteroid Belt

lines.text: The asteroid belt is full of giant space rocks, all tumbling around the Sun!
lines.note: journey fact 1 at the Asteroid Belt

lines.text: The asteroid belt sits between Mars and Jupiter, like a ring of rubble.
lines.note: journey fact 2 at the Asteroid Belt

lines.text: The biggest rock in the belt is called Ceres, and it is round like a little planet!
lines.note: journey fact 3 at the Asteroid Belt

lines.text: The rocks are so far apart that a spaceship flies straight through without bumping one!
lines.note: journey fact 4 at the Asteroid Belt
journey arrival at Jupiter

lines.text: Jupiter is the biggest planet of all — one thousand Earths could fit inside it!
lines.note: journey fact 1 at Jupiter

lines.text: Jupiter has a storm called the Great Red Spot, and it is wider than the whole Earth!
lines.note: journey fact 2 at Jupiter

lines.text: Jupiter is not solid like Earth. It is an enormous ball of swirling gas!
lines.note: journey fact 3 at Jupiter

lines.text: Jupiter has a crowd of moons going round it — more than ninety of them!
lines.note: journey fact 4 at Jupiter
journey arrival at Saturn

lines.text: Saturn’s beautiful rings are made of billions of pieces of sparkling ice!
lines.note: journey fact 1 at Saturn

lines.text: Saturn is so light for its size that it would float in a giant bath of water!
lines.note: journey fact 2 at Saturn

lines.text: A day on Saturn is short. It spins all the way round in about ten hours!
lines.note: journey fact 3 at Saturn

lines.text: Saturn’s biggest moon is called Titan, and it has rivers — but not rivers of water!
lines.note: journey fact 4 at Saturn
journey arrival at the Milky Way

lines.text: Our galaxy is called the Milky Way — it has more stars than you could ever count!
lines.note: journey fact 1 at the Milky Way

lines.text: Our Sun is just one star in the Milky Way, and there are billions more!
lines.note: journey fact 2 at the Milky Way

lines.text: From far away, the Milky Way looks like an enormous spinning pinwheel of stars.
lines.note: journey fact 3 at the Milky Way

lines.text: Earth, the Moon, Mars, Saturn — everywhere you have been today lives inside the Milky Way!
lines.note: journey fact 4 at the Milky Way

lines.text: Journey complete! You reached the Milky Way!
